versions.subject: fix: Service Installation 7045 field confusion
versions.detection:
service:
   Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
   EventID:
      - 7045
      - 7036
selection:
   - ServiceName|contains:
      - 'WCESERVICE'
      - 'WCE SERVICE'
      - 'winexesvc'
      - 'DumpSvc'
      - 'pwdump'
      - 'gsecdump'
      - 'cachedump'
   - ImagePath|contains:
      - 'bypass'  # https://gist.github.com/tyranid/c24cfd1bd141d14d4925043ee7e03c82#file-scmuacbypass-cpp-L159
condition: service and selection
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID IN (7045, 7036) ServiceName IN ("*WCESERVICE*", "*WCE SERVICE*", "*winexesvc*", "*DumpSvc*", "*pwdump*", "*gsecdump*", "*cachedump*") OR ImagePath="*bypass*"
